ask.question: How many pallets (loads) are stored per location area?
ask.sql:
WITH loads_by_location AS (
    SELECT l.STOLOC,
           COUNT(DISTINCT l.LODNUM) AS load_cnt
    FROM dbo.invlod l
    WHERE l.WH_ID = @wh_id
      AND l.LODNUM IS NOT NULL
      AND l.STOLOC IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY l.STOLOC
),
loads_by_area AS (
    SELECT m.ARECOD,
           SUM(x.load_cnt) AS load_cnt
    FROM loads_by_location x
    JOIN dbo.locmst m
      ON m.WH_ID = @wh_id
     AND m.STOLOC = x.STOLOC
    GROUP BY m.ARECOD
)
SELECT a.BLDG_ID      AS building_id,
       x.ARECOD       AS area_code,
       x.load_cnt     AS pallets_loads_stored
FROM loads_by_area x
JOIN dbo.aremst a
  ON a.WH_ID = @wh_id
 AND a.ARECOD = x.ARECOD
ORDER BY a.BLDG_ID, x.ARECOD;

ask.question: Which parts have no footprint detail?
ask.sql:
SELECT TOP (200)
    p.PRTNUM,
    p.WH_ID_TMPL
FROM dbo.prtmst AS p
WHERE
    p.WH_ID_TMPL = @wh_id
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl AS f
        WHERE
            f.WH_ID = @wh_id
            AND f.PRTNUM = p.PRTNUM
    )
ORDER BY
    p.PRTNUM;

ask.question: Count open pick work per wave / pick batch
warnings: Executed but returned 0 rows - check filters / parameter values before trusting it.
ask.sql:
/* Count open pick work per wave / pick batch -> PrIME 2022
   Param: @wh_id
   NOTE: With the provided table list there is no wave/pick-batch key available (e.g., wave, batch, list_id, assign_num).
         The closest available grouping is pick work reference (pick_buffer.wrkref), treated here as the “batch/wave handle”. */
SELECT TOP 200
       pb.wrkref,
       COUNT(*) AS open_pick_work_cnt,
       SUM(CASE WHEN pb.valid_status IS NULL OR pb.valid_status NOT IN ('VALID', 'VALIDATED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_validated_cnt,
       SUM(CASE WHEN pb.buffer_status IS NULL OR pb.buffer_status NOT IN ('CLOSED', 'COMPLETE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_closed_cnt,
       MIN(pb.ins_dt) AS first_created_dt,
       MAX(pb.last_upd_dt) AS last_updated_dt
FROM dbo.pick_buffer pb
WHERE pb.wh_id = @wh_id
  AND ISNULL(pb.is_purged, 0) = 0
  AND (pb.pick_result IS NULL OR pb.pick_result NOT IN ('COMPLETE', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'CANCELED'))
GROUP BY pb.wrkref
ORDER BY open_pick_work_cnt DESC, pb.wrkref;

ask.question: List the 20 most recent inventory movements with part, quantity and from / to location
warnings: Empty in every returned row: OPRCOD
ask.sql:
WITH mv AS (
    SELECT TOP (20)
           d.TRNDTE,
           d.DLYTRN_ID,
           d.OPRCOD,
           d.ACTCOD,
           d.PRTNUM,
           d.PRT_CLIENT_ID,
           p.DSP_PRTNUM,
           d.TRNQTY,
           d.FR_ARECOD,
           d.FRSTOL,
           d.TO_ARECOD,
           d.TOSTOL
    FROM dbo.dlytrn d
    LEFT JOIN dbo.prtmst p
           ON p.PRTNUM = d.PRTNUM
          AND p.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
          AND p.WH_ID_TMPL = @wh_id
    WHERE d.WH_ID = @wh_id
      AND d.FRSTOL IS NOT NULL
      AND d.TOSTOL IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY d.TRNDTE DESC, d.DLYTRN_ID DESC
)
SELECT mv.TRNDTE,
       mv.DLYTRN_ID,
       mv.ACTCOD,
       mv.OPRCOD,
       mv.PRT_CLIENT_ID,
       mv.PRTNUM,
       mv.DSP_PRTNUM,
       mv.TRNQTY     AS qty,
       mv.FR_ARECOD  AS from_area,
       mv.FRSTOL     AS from_location,
       mv.TO_ARECOD  AS to_area,
       mv.TOSTOL     AS to_location
FROM mv
ORDER BY mv.TRNDTE DESC, mv.DLYTRN_ID DESC;

ask.question: How many locations exist per area, and how many of them are empty?
ask.sql:
SELECT m.ARECOD AS arecod,
       COUNT(*) AS location_cnt,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(m.CURQVL, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(m.PNDQVL, 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS empty_location_cnt
FROM dbo.locmst m
JOIN dbo.aremst a
  ON a.ARECOD = m.ARECOD
 AND a.WH_ID  = m.WH_ID
WHERE m.WH_ID = @wh_id
GROUP BY m.ARECOD
ORDER BY m.ARECOD;

ask.question: Inventory quantity per part and inventory status
warnings: Empty in every returned row: pakqty
ask.sql:
/* Inventory quantity per part and inventory status -> PrIME 2022 (no pckwrk_view)
   Params: @wh_id */
SELECT i.PRTNUM,
       i.PRT_CLIENT_ID,
       i.INVSTS,
       SUM(CAST(ISNULL(i.UNTQTY, 0) AS bigint)) AS untqty,
       SUM(CAST(ISNULL(i.UNTQTY, 0) AS decimal(19,3)) / NULLIF(CAST(ISNULL(u.UNTQTY, 0) AS decimal(19,3)), 0)) AS casqty,
       SUM(CAST(ISNULL(i.UNTQTY, 0) AS decimal(19,3)) / NULLIF(CAST(ISNULL(pu.UNTQTY, 0) AS decimal(19,3)), 0)) AS pakqty
FROM dbo.inventory_view i
JOIN dbo.prtmst p
  ON p.PRTNUM = i.PRTNUM
 AND p.PRT_CLIENT_ID = i.PRT_CLIENT_ID
 AND p.WH_ID_TMPL = @wh_id
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1 f.UNTQTY
    FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl f
    WHERE f.PRTNUM = i.PRTNUM
      AND f.PRT_CLIENT_ID = i.PRT_CLIENT_ID
      AND f.WH_ID = @wh_id
      AND f.CAS_FLG = 1
    ORDER BY f.UOMLVL
) u
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1 f.UNTQTY
    FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl f
    WHERE f.PRTNUM = i.PRTNUM
      AND f.PRT_CLIENT_ID = i.PRT_CLIENT_ID
      AND f.WH_ID = @wh_id
      AND f.PAK_FLG = 1
    ORDER BY f.UOMLVL
) pu
WHERE i.WH_ID = @wh_id
GROUP BY i.PRTNUM, i.PRT_CLIENT_ID, i.INVSTS
ORDER BY i.PRTNUM, i.PRT_CLIENT_ID, i.INVSTS;

ask.question: How many pallets (loads) are stored per location area?
ask.sql:
WITH loads_per_location AS (
    SELECT l.wh_id,
           l.stoloc,
           COUNT(DISTINCT l.lodnum) AS loads_in_location
    FROM dbo.invlod l
    WHERE l.wh_id = @wh_id
      AND l.stoloc IS NOT NULL
      AND l.lodnum IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY l.wh_id, l.stoloc
)
SELECT m.arecod                                   AS location_area,
       COUNT(DISTINCT x.stoloc)                   AS locations_with_loads,
       SUM(x.loads_in_location)                   AS loads_stored
FROM loads_per_location x
JOIN dbo.locmst m
  ON m.wh_id  = x.wh_id
 AND m.stoloc = x.stoloc
JOIN dbo.aremst a
  ON a.wh_id  = m.wh_id
 AND a.arecod = m.arecod
WHERE m.wh_id = @wh_id
GROUP BY m.arecod
ORDER BY loads_stored DESC, m.arecod;

ask.question: Top 20 parts by number of pallets in stock
ask.sql:
WITH wh AS (
    SELECT TOP 1 CAST(@wh_id AS nvarchar(50)) AS wh_id
),
pallets_by_part AS (
    SELECT
        d.prtnum,
        d.prt_client_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT l.lodnum) AS pallet_cnt
    FROM prodwms.invdtl d
    CROSS JOIN wh
    JOIN prodwms.invlod l
        ON l.lodnum = d.subnum
       AND l.wh_id  = wh.wh_id
    WHERE d.untqty > 0
    GROUP BY
        d.prtnum,
        d.prt_client_id
)
SELECT TOP 20
    p.prtnum,
    p.prt_client_id,
    pm.dsp_prtnum,
    p.pallet_cnt
FROM pallets_by_part p
CROSS JOIN wh
LEFT JOIN prodwms.prtmst pm
    ON pm.prtnum = p.prtnum
   AND pm.prt_client_id = p.prt_client_id
   AND pm.wh_id_tmpl = wh.wh_id  -- WHT guard to avoid dual-row ('----') duplication
ORDER BY
    p.pallet_cnt DESC,
    p.prtnum,
    p.prt_client_id;

ask.question: How many unit loads are in each location zone?
ask.sql:
SELECT
    l.subsit,
    l.zoncod AS location_zone,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.ulid) AS unit_loads
FROM [EUSKIRCHEN_simp].live3.locatn l
JOIN [EUSKIRCHEN_simp].live3.sysdtl d
    ON d.subsit = l.subsit
   AND d.locatn = l.locatn
WHERE l.subsit IN ('0','1')
  AND d.ulid IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    l.subsit,
    l.zoncod
ORDER BY
    l.subsit,
    l.zoncod;

ask.question: Top 20 items by number of unit loads in stock
ask.sql:
WITH ul_by_item AS (
    SELECT u.itmcls,
           u.itmcod,
           COUNT(DISTINCT u.ulid20) AS unit_loads_in_stock
    FROM [EUSKIRCHEN_simp].live3.untdtl u
    WHERE u.casqty > 0
    GROUP BY u.itmcls, u.itmcod
)
SELECT TOP 200
       u.itmcls,
       u.itmcod,
       it.itmdsc,
       it.itmgrp,
       ig.grpdsc AS itmgrp_description,
       u.unit_loads_in_stock
FROM ul_by_item u
JOIN [EUSKIRCHEN_simp].live3.itmmst it
  ON it.itmcls = u.itmcls
 AND it.itmcod = u.itmcod
LEFT JOIN [EUSKIRCHEN_simp].live3.itmgrp ig
  ON ig.itmcls = it.itmcls
 AND ig.itmgrp = it.itmgrp
ORDER BY u.unit_loads_in_stock DESC, u.itmcls, u.itmcod;

convert.title: CBO_P_CLASS_INVENTORY_DE07_VIEW
convert.sql:
WITH s1 AS
(
    SELECT DISTINCT
        iv.stoloc AS LOCATN,
        iv.prtnum AS ITMCOD,
        prt.prtfam AS ITMGRP,
        iv.lodnum AS ULID20,
        iv.untqty AS CASQTY,
        iv.invsts AS QASTAT,
        iv.fifdte AS FIFODT,
        iv.lotnum AS CTLGRP,
        iv.ftpcod AS ULPALL,
        lo.arecod AS ZONCOD,
        CASE
            WHEN lo.arecod = 'X1' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Halle 1')
            WHEN lo.arecod = 'X2' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Halle 2')
            WHEN lo.arecod = 'X3' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Halle 3')
            WHEN lo.arecod = 'X4' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Halle 4')
            WHEN lo.arecod = 'X5' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Halle 5')
            WHEN lo.arecod = 'XC' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Modul')
            ELSE CONVERT(varchar(10), 'not defined')
        END AS BLDING,
        CASE
            WHEN SUBSTRING(prt.prtfam, 1, 1) = 'W' OR prt.prtfam = 'PAPPWP' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Wipes')
            WHEN SUBSTRING(prt.prtfam, 1, 1) = 'R' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Rawmaterial')
            WHEN SUBSTRING(prt.prtfam, 1, 1) = 'P' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Packmaterial')
            ELSE CONVERT(varchar(12), 'not defined')
        END AS MATTYP
    FROM dbo.inventory_view AS iv
    INNER JOIN dbo.locmst AS lo
        ON lo.wh_id = iv.wh_id
       AND lo.stoloc = iv.stoloc
    INNER JOIN dbo.prtmst AS prt
        ON prt.prtnum = iv.prtnum
       AND prt.wh_id_tmpl = @wh_id
    WHERE iv.wh_id = @wh_id
      AND iv.prmflg = 1
),
s2 AS
(
    SELECT
        pftv.prtnum AS ITMCOD,
        pftd.uomcod AS UOM,
        pftv.untlay AS ITMCNF_CASLAY,
        (pftv.untlay * pftv.untpal) AS ITMMST_QTY,
        pftv.ftpcod AS ULPALL,
        pftd.hgt AS U_HEIGHT,
        CASE WHEN pftd.pal_flg = 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PALFLG
    FROM dbo.prtftp_view AS pftv
    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            d.uomcod,
            d.hgt,
            d.pal_flg
        FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl AS d
        WHERE d.prtnum = pftv.prtnum
          AND d.prt_client_id = pftv.prt_client_id
          AND d.wh_id = pftv.wh_id
          AND d.ftpcod = pftv.ftpcod
          AND d.stk_flg = 1
        ORDER BY d.uomlvl
    ) AS pftd
    WHERE pftv.wh_id = @wh_id
)
SELECT TOP (200)
    s1.LOCATN,
    s1.ITMCOD,
    s1.ITMGRP,
    s1.ULID20,
    s1.CASQTY,
    s1.QASTAT,
    s1.FIFODT,
    s1.CTLGRP,
    s1.ULPALL,
    s1.ZONCOD,
    CONVERT(datetime, GETDATE()) AS last_update,
    s1.BLDING,
    s1.MATTYP,
    (CASE WHEN s2.PALFLG = 'Y' THEN CONVERT(int, s2.U_HEIGHT + 15) ELSE CONVERT(int, s2.U_HEIGHT) END) AS calculated_pal_height,
    s2.UOM,
    iv.vc_vndnum AS VNDCOD,
    iv.sup_lotnum AS VNDLOT,
    CONCAT(s1.ULPALL, s1.ITMCOD) AS ULPAL_ITEM
FROM s1
INNER JOIN s2
    ON s2.ITMCOD = s1.ITMCOD
   AND s2.ULPALL = s1.ULPALL
INNER JOIN dbo.inventory_view AS iv
    ON iv.wh_id = @wh_id
   AND iv.stoloc = s1.LOCATN
   AND iv.prtnum = s1.ITMCOD
   AND iv.lodnum = s1.ULID20;

convert.title: Direct_LINE_BEVO_PRIORITIES
convert.sql:
WITH rl AS (
    SELECT
        il.lodnum         AS ULID,
        il.stoloc         AS locatn,
        id.prtnum         AS itmcod,
        id.lotnum         AS ctlgrp,
        id.sup_lotnum     AS vndlot,
        id.supnum         AS vndcod
    FROM dbo.invlod il
    JOIN dbo.invsub isb
        ON isb.lodnum = il.lodnum
    JOIN dbo.invdtl id
        ON id.subnum = isb.subnum
       AND id.dtlnum = isb.subnum
    WHERE il.wh_id = @wh_id
      AND il.stoloc NOT LIKE '%RWZ%'
      -- OBS7(dropped): ud.itmcls = 'P' (no item class available in allowed PrIME tables/columns)
      -- OBS7(dropped): ct.qastat = 'RL' (no QA status available in allowed PrIME tables/columns)
),
B AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(ULID) AS ULIDs,
        locatn,
        itmcod,
        vndlot,
        vndcod
    FROM rl
    GROUP BY locatn, itmcod, vndlot, vndcod
),
D_lot AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(ULID) AS ULIDs,
        vndcod,
        vndlot
    FROM rl
    GROUP BY vndcod, vndlot
),
E AS (
    SELECT
        h.wkonum                                         AS PRDORD,
        h.sch_begdte                                     AS ACTDAT,
        h.sch_enddte                                     AS ENDDAT,
        wd.prtnum                                        AS SPCCD1,
        SUM(wd.linqty - ISNULL(wd.tot_dlvqty, 0))        AS Offener_Bedarf_IN_WM_Unit,
        h.prdlin                                         AS LINIE,
        h.prtnum                                         AS ITMCOD
    FROM dbo.wkohdr h
    JOIN dbo.wkodtl wd
        ON wd.wkonum = h.wkonum
       AND wd.client_id = h.client_id
       AND wd.wkorev = h.wkorev
       AND wd.wh_id = h.wh_id
    WHERE h.wh_id = @wh_id
      -- OBS7(dropped): R.SPCCD1_ITMCLS = 'P' (no item class available in allowed PrIME tables/columns)
      -- OBS7(dropped): Q.COMPLETE_FLAG = 'A' (no completion flag available in allowed PrIME tables/columns)
      -- OBS7(dropped): L.SUBSIT = '0' (no subsite column available in allowed PrIME tables/columns)
      AND (wd.linqty - ISNULL(wd.tot_dlvqty, 0)) > 0
    GROUP BY
        h.wkonum, h.sch_begdte, h.sch_enddte, wd.prtnum, h.prdlin, h.prtnum
)
SELECT TOP (200)
    h.prdlin                                 AS PLNUMB,
    h.wkonum                                 AS PRDORD,
    E.ACTDAT                                 AS ACTDAT,
    E.ENDDAT                                 AS ENDDAT,
    wd.prtnum                                AS ITMCOD,
    wd.prtnum                                AS SPCCOD,
    wd.seqnum                                AS LINSEQ,
    wd.prcloc                                AS LOCATN,
    wd.lotnum                                AS CTLGRP,
    wd.supnum                                AS VNDCOD,
    wd.sup_lotnum                            AS VNDLOT,
    B.ULIDs                                  AS ULIDs_anhand_Ort,
    D_lot.ULIDs                              AS ULIDs_anhand_Vendor_Lot,
    FORMAT(MAX(t.trndte), 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm') AS Last_Update
FROM dbo.wkohdr h
JOIN dbo.wkodtl wd
    ON wd.wkonum = h.wkonum
   AND wd.client_id = h.client_id
   AND wd.wkorev = h.wkorev
   AND wd.wh_id = h.wh_id
LEFT JOIN B
    ON wd.prtnum = B.itmcod
   AND wd.prcloc = B.locatn
   AND wd.sup_lotnum = B.vndlot
   AND wd.supnum = B.vndcod
LEFT JOIN D_lot
    ON wd.supnum = D_lot.vndcod
   AND wd.sup_lotnum = D_lot.vndlot
LEFT JOIN E
    ON wd.prtnum = E.ITMCOD
   AND wd.prtnum = E.SPCCD1
   AND h.wkonum = E.PRDORD
CROSS JOIN dbo.dlytrn t
WHERE h.wh_id = @wh_id
GROUP BY
    h.prdlin, h.wkonum, E.ACTDAT, E.ENDDAT, wd.prtnum, wd.seqnum, wd.prcloc, wd.lotnum, wd.supnum, wd.sup_lotnum,
    B.ULIDs, D_lot.ULIDs
ORDER BY
    h.prdlin, h.wkonum, wd.seqnum;

convert.title: equip
convert.sql:
SELECT TOP (200)
       v.vehtyp_id AS equip,
       COALESCE(d.short_dsc, d.lngdsc) AS equip_desc
FROM dbo.vehtyp AS v
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP (1)
           d1.short_dsc,
           d1.lngdsc
    FROM dbo.dscmst AS d1
    WHERE d1.colnam = N'vehtyp_id'
      AND d1.colval = v.vehtyp_id
      AND ISNULL(d1.is_purged, 0) = 0
    ORDER BY
        CASE WHEN d1.short_dsc IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
        CASE WHEN d1.lngdsc  IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
) AS d
WHERE ISNULL(v.is_purged, 0) = 0
ORDER BY v.vehtyp_id;

convert.title: IMP_LINE_DELIVERY_HISTORY_FROM_DAS
convert.sql:
WITH base_p1 AS (
    SELECT
        CASE d.frstol WHEN 'SILOB' THEN 'ULINA4' WHEN 'SILOA' THEN 'ULINA3' ELSE d.frstol END AS LOCATN,
        d.trndte AS SYSDAT,
        d.prtnum AS ITMCOD,
        LEFT(pd.lngdsc, 15) AS ITMDSC,
        d.lotnum AS CTLGRP,
        LEFT(i.supnum, 4) AS VNDCOD,
        i.sup_lotnum AS VNDLOT,
        d.trnqty AS TRNQTY,
        pfd.uomcod AS UOM,
        SUBSTRING(d.movref, 4, 9) AS PRDORD,
        LEFT(d.lodnum, 20) AS ULID
    FROM dbo.dlytrn d
    JOIN dbo.invdtl i
        ON i.dtlnum = d.dtlnum
       AND i.subnum = d.subnum
    JOIN dbo.prtmst pm
        ON pm.prtnum = d.prtnum
       AND pm.prt_client_id = d.prt_client_id
       AND pm.wh_id_tmpl = @wh_id
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) pd1.lngdsc
        FROM dbo.prtdsc pd1
        WHERE pd1.colnam = 'prtmst.prtnum'
          AND pd1.colval = pm.prtnum
          AND pd1.is_purged = 0
        ORDER BY pd1.locale_id
    ) pd
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) pfd1.uomcod
        FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl pfd1
        WHERE pfd1.prtnum = d.prtnum
          AND pfd1.prt_client_id = d.prt_client_id
          AND pfd1.wh_id = @wh_id
          AND pfd1.is_purged = 0
        ORDER BY pfd1.uomlvl
    ) pfd
    WHERE d.trndte > DATEADD(day, -3, GETDATE())
      AND d.frstol LIKE 'ULIN%'
      AND d.actcod IN ('DEPSUL', 'LINUSE')          -- tag: CODESET_DIFFERS from RTCIS TRNTYP
      AND d.wh_id = @wh_id
),
sq1 AS (
    SELECT
        CASE d.frstol WHEN 'SILOB' THEN 'ULINA4' WHEN 'SILOA' THEN 'ULINA3' ELSE d.frstol END AS LOCATN,
        d.dlytrn_id
    FROM dbo.dlytrn d
    WHERE d.trndte > DATEADD(day, -3, GETDATE())
      AND d.frstol LIKE 'ULIN%'
      AND d.oprcod = 'T'                           -- tag: CODESET_DIFFERS from RTCIS DTLTYP
      AND d.movref IS NOT NULL                     -- movref used as PRDORD source
      AND d.wh_id = @wh_id
),
base_p2 AS (
    SELECT
        sq1.LOCATN,
        d.trndte AS SYSDAT,
        d.prtnum AS ITMCOD,
        LEFT(pd.lngdsc, 15) AS ITMDSC,
        d.lotnum AS CTLGRP,
        LEFT(i.supnum, 4) AS VNDCOD,
        i.sup_lotnum AS VNDLOT,
        d.trnqty AS TRNQTY,
        pfd.uomcod AS UOM,
        SUBSTRING(d.movref, 4, 9) AS PRDORD,
        LEFT(d.lodnum, 20) AS ULID
    FROM dbo.dlytrn d
    JOIN sq1
        ON sq1.dlytrn_id = d.dlytrn_id
    JOIN dbo.invdtl i
        ON i.dtlnum = d.dtlnum
       AND i.subnum = d.subnum
    JOIN dbo.prtmst pm
        ON pm.prtnum = d.prtnum
       AND pm.prt_client_id = d.prt_client_id
       AND pm.wh_id_tmpl = @wh_id
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) pd1.lngdsc
        FROM dbo.prtdsc pd1
        WHERE pd1.colnam = 'prtmst.prtnum'
          AND pd1.colval = pm.prtnum
          AND pd1.is_purged = 0
        ORDER BY pd1.locale_id
    ) pd
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) pfd1.uomcod
        FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl pfd1
        WHERE pfd1.prtnum = d.prtnum
          AND pfd1.prt_client_id = d.prt_client_id
          AND pfd1.wh_id = @wh_id
          AND pfd1.is_purged = 0
        ORDER BY pfd1.uomlvl
    ) pfd
    WHERE d.trndte > DATEADD(day, -3, GETDATE())
      AND d.oprcod = 'F'                           -- tag: CODESET_DIFFERS from RTCIS DTLTYP
      AND d.actcod = 'CASXFR'                      -- tag: CODESET_DIFFERS from RTCIS TRNTYP
      AND d.movref IS NOT NULL
      AND d.wh_id = @wh_id
)
SELECT TOP (200)
    LOCATN AS LINE,
    FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS DELIVERY_DATE,
    ITMCOD,
    ITMDSC AS DESCRIPTION,
    CTLGRP,
    VNDCOD AS VENDOR,
    VNDLOT AS VENDOR_LOT,
    TRNQTY AS QTY,
    UOM AS WM_UNIT,
    PRDORD AS PROCESS_ORDER,
    ULID,
    CONCAT(ULID, FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss')) AS ID_NR
FROM base_p1
UNION
SELECT TOP (200)
    LOCATN,
    FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'),
    ITMCOD,
    ITMDSC,
    CTLGRP,
    VNDCOD,
    VNDLOT,
    TRNQTY,
    UOM,
    PRDORD,
    ULID,
    CONCAT(ULID, FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss'))
FROM base_p2;

convert.title: IMP_LINE_DELIVERY_HISTORY_FROM_RTCIS
convert.sql:
WITH p1 AS (
    SELECT
        CASE d.tostol WHEN 'SILOB' THEN 'ULINA4' WHEN 'SILOA' THEN 'ULINA3' ELSE d.tostol END AS LOCATN,
        d.trndte AS SYSDAT,
        d.prtnum AS ITMCOD,
        LEFT(pd.lngdsc, 15) AS ITMDSC,
        d.lotnum AS CTLGRP,
        LEFT(id.supnum, 4) AS VNDCOD,
        id.sup_lotnum AS VNDLOT,
        d.trnqty AS TRNQTY,
        u.uomcod AS UOM,
        SUBSTRING(d.movref, 4, 9) AS PRDORD,
        LEFT(d.lodnum, 20) AS ULID
    FROM dbo.dlytrn d
    LEFT JOIN dbo.invdtl id
        ON id.dtlnum = d.dtlnum
       AND id.subnum = d.subnum
    LEFT JOIN dbo.prtmst pm
        ON pm.prtnum = d.prtnum
       AND pm.wh_id_tmpl = @wh_id
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            p.lngdsc
        FROM dbo.prtdsc p
        WHERE p.colnam = 'prtnum'
          AND p.colval = d.prtnum
          AND ISNULL(p.is_purged, 0) = 0
    ) pd
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            pfd.uomcod
        FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl pfd
        WHERE pfd.prtnum = d.prtnum
          AND pfd.prt_client_id = d.prt_client_id
          AND pfd.wh_id = @wh_id
          AND ISNULL(pfd.is_purged, 0) = 0
        ORDER BY pfd.uomlvl
    ) u
    WHERE d.wh_id = @wh_id
      AND d.tostol LIKE 'ULIN%'
      AND d.actcod IN ('DEPSUL', 'LINUSE')
      AND d.trndte >= DATEADD(minute, -120, GETDATE())
      AND d.trndte <= GETDATE()
),
sq1 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        CASE d.tostol WHEN 'SILOB' THEN 'ULINA4' WHEN 'SILOA' THEN 'ULINA3' ELSE d.tostol END AS LOCATN,
        d.dlytrn_id AS TRNSEQ
    FROM dbo.dlytrn d
    WHERE d.wh_id = @wh_id
      AND d.tostol LIKE 'ULIN%'
      AND d.oprcod = 'T'
      AND d.movref IS NOT NULL
      AND d.trndte >= DATEADD(minute, -120, GETDATE())
      AND d.trndte <= GETDATE()
),
p2 AS (
    SELECT
        sq1.LOCATN,
        d.trndte AS SYSDAT,
        d.prtnum AS ITMCOD,
        LEFT(pd.lngdsc, 15) AS ITMDSC,
        d.lotnum AS CTLGRP,
        LEFT(id.supnum, 4) AS VNDCOD,
        id.sup_lotnum AS VNDLOT,
        d.trnqty AS TRNQTY,
        u.uomcod AS UOM,
        SUBSTRING(d.movref, 4, 9) AS PRDORD,
        LEFT(d.lodnum, 20) AS ULID
    FROM dbo.dlytrn d
    JOIN sq1
        ON sq1.TRNSEQ = d.dlytrn_id
    LEFT JOIN dbo.invdtl id
        ON id.dtlnum = d.dtlnum
       AND id.subnum = d.subnum
    LEFT JOIN dbo.prtmst pm
        ON pm.prtnum = d.prtnum
       AND pm.wh_id_tmpl = @wh_id
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            p.lngdsc
        FROM dbo.prtdsc p
        WHERE p.colnam = 'prtnum'
          AND p.colval = d.prtnum
          AND ISNULL(p.is_purged, 0) = 0
    ) pd
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            pfd.uomcod
        FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl pfd
        WHERE pfd.prtnum = d.prtnum
          AND pfd.prt_client_id = d.prt_client_id
          AND pfd.wh_id = @wh_id
          AND ISNULL(pfd.is_purged, 0) = 0
        ORDER BY pfd.uomlvl
    ) u
    WHERE d.wh_id = @wh_id
      AND d.oprcod = 'F'
      AND d.actcod = 'CASXFR'
      AND d.movref IS NOT NULL
      AND d.trndte >= DATEADD(minute, -120, GETDATE())
      AND d.trndte <= GETDATE()
)
SELECT TOP (200)
    LOCATN AS LINE,
    FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS DELIVERY_DATE,
    ITMCOD,
    ITMDSC AS DESCRIPTION,
    CTLGRP,
    VNDCOD AS VENDOR,
    VNDLOT AS VENDOR_LOT,
    TRNQTY AS QTY,
    UOM AS WM_UNIT,
    PRDORD AS PROCESS_ORDER,
    ULID,
    CONCAT(ULID, FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss')) AS ID_NR
FROM p1
UNION
SELECT
    LOCATN AS LINE,
    FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS DELIVERY_DATE,
    ITMCOD,
    ITMDSC AS DESCRIPTION,
    CTLGRP,
    VNDCOD AS VENDOR,
    VNDLOT AS VENDOR_LOT,
    TRNQTY AS QTY,
    UOM AS WM_UNIT,
    PRDORD AS PROCESS_ORDER,
    ULID,
    CONCAT(ULID, FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss')) AS ID_NR
FROM p2;

convert.title: IMP_LINE_RETURN_HISTORY_FROM_DAS
convert.sql:
SELECT TOP (200)
       CASE d.to_stol WHEN 'SILOB' THEN 'ULINA4' WHEN 'SILOA' THEN 'ULINA3' ELSE d.to_stol END AS LINE,
       FORMAT(d.trndte, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS RETURN_DATE,
       d.prtnum AS ITMCOD,
       LEFT(COALESCE(dsc.short_dsc, dsc.lngdsc), 15) AS DESCRIPTION,
       d.lotnum AS CTLGRP,
       LEFT(d.sup_lotnum, 4) AS VENDOR,
       d.sup_lotnum AS VENDOR_LOT,
       d.trnqty AS QTY,
       uom.uomcod AS WM_UNIT,
       SUBSTRING(d.movref, 4, 9) AS PROCESS_ORDER,
       d.lodnum AS ULID,
       CONCAT(d.lodnum, FORMAT(d.trndte, 'yyyy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss')) AS ID_NR
FROM dbo.dlytrn d
JOIN dbo.prtmst pm
  ON pm.prtnum = d.prtnum
 AND pm.wh_id_tmpl = @wh_id
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP (1) pd.short_dsc, pd.lngdsc
    FROM dbo.prtdsc pd
    WHERE pd.colnam = 'prtnum'
      AND pd.colval = d.prtnum
      AND pd.is_purged = 0
) dsc
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP (1) pfd.uomcod
    FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl pfd
    WHERE pfd.prtnum = d.prtnum
      AND pfd.wh_id = @wh_id
      AND pfd.is_purged = 0
    ORDER BY pfd.uomlvl
) uom
WHERE d.wh_id = @wh_id
  AND pm.typcod = 'P'
  AND d.to_stol LIKE 'ULIN%'
  AND d.actcod = 'MANLID'
  AND d.trndte > DATEADD(DAY, -3, GETDATE());

convert.title: IMP_LINE_RETURN_HISTORY_FROM_RTCIS
convert.sql:
SELECT TOP (200)
       CASE dly.tostol
            WHEN 'SILOB' THEN 'ULINA4'
            WHEN 'SILOA' THEN 'ULINA3'
            ELSE dly.tostol
       END AS LINE,
       FORMAT(dly.trndte, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS RETURN_DATE,
       dly.prtnum AS ITMCOD,
       LEFT(COALESCE(prtdsc_oa.lngdsc, prtdsc_oa.short_dsc), 15) AS DESCRIPTION,
       dly.lotnum AS CTLGRP,
       LEFT(inv.supnum, 4) AS VENDOR,
       inv.sup_lotnum AS VENDOR_LOT,
       dly.trnqty AS QTY,
       prtftp_dtl_oa.uomcod AS WM_UNIT,
       SUBSTRING(dly.movref, 4, 9) AS PROCESS_ORDER,
       dly.lodnum AS ULID,
       CONCAT(dly.lodnum, FORMAT(dly.trndte, 'yyyy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss')) AS ID_NR
FROM dbo.dlytrn dly
JOIN dbo.prtmst prt
  ON prt.prtnum = dly.prtnum
 AND prt.WH_ID_TMPL = @wh_id
LEFT JOIN dbo.invdtl inv
  ON inv.dtlnum = dly.dtlnum
 AND inv.subnum = dly.subnum
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP (1)
           pd.lngdsc,
           pd.short_dsc
    FROM dbo.prtdsc pd
    WHERE pd.colnam = 'prtnum'
      AND pd.colval = dly.prtnum
      AND pd.is_purged = 0
    ORDER BY pd.locale_id
) prtdsc_oa
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP (1)
           pfd.uomcod
    FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl pfd
    WHERE pfd.prtnum = dly.prtnum
      AND pfd.prt_client_id = dly.prt_client_id
      AND pfd.wh_id = @wh_id
      AND pfd.is_purged = 0
    ORDER BY pfd.uomlvl
) prtftp_dtl_oa
WHERE dly.wh_id = @wh_id
  AND prt.typcod = 'P'
  AND dly.tostol LIKE 'ULIN%'
  AND dly.actcod = 'MANLID'
  AND dly.trndte > DATEADD(day, -33, GETDATE())
  AND dly.trndte <= GETDATE();

convert.title: IMP_LINE_RETURNS_90days_wholeQtyBack
convert.sql:
WITH deliv AS (
    SELECT
        dt.trndte AS DELIVERY_DATE,
        CASE dt.tostol
            WHEN 'SILOB' THEN 'ULINA4'
            WHEN 'SILOA' THEN 'ULINA3'
            ELSE dt.tostol
        END AS LINE,
        dt.movref AS PROCESS_ORDER,
        dt.prtnum AS ITMCOD,
        dt.trnqty AS QTY,
        uom.WHSE_UNIT,
        LEFT(dt.lodnum, 20) AS ULID
    FROM dbo.dlytrn dt
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            pfd.uomcod AS WHSE_UNIT
        FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl pfd
        WHERE pfd.prtnum = dt.prtnum
          AND pfd.wh_id = @wh_id
          AND pfd.is_purged = 0
        ORDER BY pfd.uomlvl ASC, pfd.uomcod ASC
    ) uom
    WHERE dt.wh_id = @wh_id
      AND dt.tostol LIKE 'ULIN%'
      AND dt.actcod IN ('DEPSUL', 'LINUSE')  -- value-mapping unknown; kept literal per source
),
ret AS (
    SELECT
        dt.lodnum AS ULID,
        dt.trndte AS RETURN_DATE,
        dt.trnqty AS QTY
    FROM dbo.dlytrn dt
    WHERE dt.wh_id = @wh_id
      AND dt.tostol LIKE 'ULIN%'
      AND dt.actcod = 'MANLID'  -- value-mapping unknown; kept literal per source
),
RankedDeliveries AS (
    SELECT
        a.DELIVERY_DATE,
        a.LINE,
        a.PROCESS_ORDER,
        a.ITMCOD,
        pm.prtfam AS ITMGRP,
        fam_dsc.grpdsc,
        a.QTY,
        a.WHSE_UNIT,
        a.ULID,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.ULID ORDER BY a.DELIVERY_DATE ASC) AS DeliveryRank
    FROM deliv a
    JOIN dbo.prtmst pm
      ON pm.prtnum = a.ITMCOD
     AND pm.WH_ID_TMPL = @wh_id
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            d.lngdsc AS grpdsc
        FROM dbo.dscmst d
        WHERE d.colnam = 'prtfam'
          AND d.colval = pm.prtfam
          AND d.is_purged = 0
        ORDER BY d.locale_id
    ) fam_dsc
    WHERE a.DELIVERY_DATE > CAST(DATEADD(DAY, -90, GETDATE()) AS date)
      AND a.DELIVERY_DATE < CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
      AND a.LINE NOT LIKE 'ULINA%'
      AND a.LINE NOT LIKE 'ULINC%'
),
RankedReturns AS (
    SELECT
        b.ULID,
        b.RETURN_DATE,
        b.QTY,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.ULID ORDER BY b.RETURN_DATE ASC) AS ReturnRank
    FROM ret b
)
SELECT TOP (200)
    d.DELIVERY_DATE,
    d.LINE,
    d.PROCESS_ORDER,
    d.ITMCOD,
    d.ITMGRP,
    d.grpdsc,
    d.QTY,
    d.WHSE_UNIT,
    d.ULID,
    r.RETURN_DATE,
    r.QTY AS RETURN_QTY,
    DATEDIFF(MINUTE, d.DELIVERY_DATE, r.RETURN_DATE) AS DATE_DIFF
FROM RankedDeliveries d
JOIN RankedReturns r
  ON d.ULID = r.ULID
 AND d.DeliveryRank = r.ReturnRank
WHERE d.DELIVERY_DATE < r.RETURN_DATE
  AND DATEDIFF(MINUTE, d.DELIVERY_DATE, r.RETURN_DATE) < 960
  AND d.QTY = r.QTY
ORDER BY d.ULID, d.DELIVERY_DATE ASC;
